title: Sorceress
text:
The elements are mine to control. I know why lightning strikes, why fire burns, and why cold freezes. They do so because I command it. The vengeance of the Maraketh will find those who have transgressed no matter where they run.
The Sorceress is an intelligence-oriented class that specializes in elemental spells.

== Ascendancy classes ==
Sorceresses can specialize into one of these three Ascendancy classes:

Stormweaver
Chronomancer
Disciple of Varashta


== Lore ==
The Sorceress is a Maraketh from the Vastiri Deserts. She was banished from her akhara for unspecified reasons; on her accord, she had left the Maraketh before taking an oath that would have bound her to them.
The Sorceress was also to be a tale-woman before her banishment.


== Dialogues ==


=== Entering locations ===


==== Act 1 ====
The Riverbank: They... will suffer for this humiliation.
Clearfell Encampment: Here, there is a small trace of hope in the air.
Clearfell: —
Mud Burrow: Disgusting. Everything is wet and vile in Ogham.
The Grelwood: It is strange to think... the Vastiri was once home to such forests...
The Red Vale: I thought the Ezomytes buried their dead... This must have been some battleground.
The Grim Tangle: Blocked for now. But I sense more than just life in these vines...
Cemetery of the Eternals: These customs are strange to me. Burying their dead... How terrible.
Mausoleum of the Praetor: Cruel Praetor... I shall bring you the storm.
Tomb of the Consort: Witches are not tolerated where I am from. I shall deal with her.
Hunting Grounds: These plains, though twisted... hold beauty.
Freythorn: Ah yes... Yet another wicked energy to contend with.
Ogham Farmlands: —
Ogham Village: I cannot control this much flame... This village is beyond saving.
The Manor Ramparts: These walls are oppressive... Who chooses to live this way?
Ogham Manor: This Mad Wolf... May he howl like ravaged Deshret.


==== Act 2 ====
Vastiri Outskirts: I did not know if I would see the Vastiri again... It is good to be home.
The Ardura Caravan: Ahh. It's been too long since I felt the rumble of a caravan beneath my feet.
Mawdun Quarry: From what I can see... the Faridun have been preparing for war. This night... now grows warm.
Mawdun Mine: This mine was sealed with some still inside... Corruption seems to have taken them.
The Halani Gates (1): The Halani Gates have been closed? This has not happened for generations.
Traitor's Passage: This passage is how the Traitor betrayed her people... Now I explore its secrets.
The Halani Gates (2): Hmmm... Dead Maraketh. The Faridun must infest this place.
Mastodon Badlands:
The Bone Pits:
Keth: Lost Keth, I can only imagine how beautiful you must have been in your time.
The Lost City: Buried beneath shifting sands... Keth still endures.
Buried Shrines: Such Shrines were not meant for mortal eyes. I am honoured.
Valley of the Titans: My akhara are permitted here, but I should not linger.
The Titan Grotto: I have heard whispers of such a place... where Titans fought and died.
Deshar: I hope there is time... to protect our honoured dead.
Path of Mourning: The Faridun should know better than to let this madness transpire...
The Spires of Deshar: —
The Dreadnought: The Faridun will fall!
Dreadnought Vanguard:
Trial of the Sekhemas: The Winter Sekhema's challenge... I am right where I deserve to be.


==== Act 3 ====
Sandswept Marsh: Ugh... The humidity is disgusting. Best get on with this.
Ziggurat Encampment: A traditional place... overrun by vagabonds. I disapprove.
Jungle Ruins: The mighty Vaal empire... Now just an overgrown jungle.
The Venom Crypts: What is worse? Snakes... or scorpions?
Infested Barrens: The ground here is cracked and broken... What lives in these hives?
The Azak Bog: Servi was right. The Azak must be dealt with.
Chimeral Wetlands: I've never seen such beauty... The Oases at home lacked such splendid colour.
Jiquani's Machinarium: Hmm... I feel a murmur of power within them.
Jiquani's Sanctum: Ahhh... I should call Alva.
The Matlan Waterways: So these are the Azak that Servi despises? I can understand why.
The Drowned City: Utzaal... You are impressive, even as a drowned ruin.
Apex of Filth: Garukhan's grace, what is that smell?
The Molten Vault: More Vaal machinery...
Temple of Kopec: The feeling... Like the desert sun.
Utzaal: I must say... the city in its prime is quite beautiful.
Aggorat:
The Black Chambers: —
The Ziggurat Refuge: Did the world really just end?
The Temple of Chaos: The tale-women say... Chaos is a fickle master.


=== Boss defeated ===


==== Act 1 ====
The Bloated Miller: He bore the mark of Corruption... I know it.
Beira of the Rotten Pack: —
The Devourer: I have wandered the Vastiri... This was not a challenge.
The Brambleghast: Waste away, back to the soil.
The Rust King: Now, Battlelord... Accept your death.
The Rotten Druid: The elements will now take you, druid.
Draven, the Eternal Praetor: Your demise is welcomed, I am sure of it.
Asinia, the Praetor's Consort: Repulsive witch. May your misdeeds be long forgotten.
Lachlann of Endless Lament: Rejoin your kin, lost one. I will remember you.
The Crowbell: Corruption spreads like wildfire, no creature is safe.
The King in the Mists: You must move on. I have. It is better this way.
The Executioner: His suffering was short-lived... It is a shame.
Candlemass, the Living Rite: Go now, defiler of flame.
Count Geonor: Hmm... the Shade is indeed powerful.


==== Act 2 ====
Rathbreaker: I leave you to the sands, foul Raiders.
Rudja, the Dread Engineer: Just don't touch me, Faridun.
Balbala, the Traitor: You fought well, traitor.
Jamanra, the Risen King: Mark my words, Jamanra - I will return you to death!
Ekbab, Ancient Steed: The darkness is now dispelled. May it stay this way.
Kabala, Constrictor Queen: My akhara will not believe this.
Azarian, the Forsaken Son: —
Zalmarath, the Colossus: More may roam here, it's time to go.
Tor Gul, the Defiler: Jamanra will pay for raising the Defiler!
Jamanra, the Abomination: Asala!


==== Act 3 ====
Rootdredge: I am victorious. Again.
Mighty Silverfist: Ouch. You should've been more careful.
Ignagduk, the Bog Witch: May your spirit shriek for eternity, vile one.
Xyclucian, the Chimeral: —
Blackjaw, the Remnant: Stone-one, your duty has ended.
Zicoatl, Warden of the Core: Alva, I should plunge you into a pit of scorpions for that!
Mektul, the Forgemaster: Oswald will be very pleased with all this gold.
The Queen of Filth: I will never be able to remove this memory from my mind.
Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun: The elements should be our servants, not our masters.
Viper Napuatzi: Did she die? What just happened?!
Doryani, Royal Thaumaturge: —


=== Level up ===
Reaching level 2: The first step on my chosen path.
Reaching level 3: To think they dared doubt me.
Reaching level 5: My way forward is clear.
Reaching level 10: My tale shall be legendary!
Reaching level 15: I will learn all the secrets of this world!
Reaching level 20: Nothing will stand in my way.
Reaching level 30: I am beginning to grasp true power.
Reaching level 40: The wrath of the desert has a new face.
Reaching level 50: The elements call to me!
Reaching level 60: Power unbound!
Reaching level 70: I've come so far, I even amaze myself.
Reaching level 80: My akhara will remember my name.
Reaching level 90: My power knows no bounds!
Reaching level 100:
I will be the new Queen of the Winds!
I will make my own legends now!
Now, they will tell tales of me!


=== Miscellaneous ===


==== Ascending ====
My path is clear.
Stormweaver: The elements are mine to wield.
Chronomancer: I shall bend time itself to my will.


==== Full inventory ====
I have no space for that.
I must travel light.
I'm carrying enough already.


==== Using ability in town ====
This isn't the place.
Now is not the time for that.
Not here... Not now.
Best not do that here.


==== Using well ====
A welcome oasis.
A refreshing sip.
That's better.


==== Respec passive point ====
A new realm of power!
Inspiring!
A step closer to legend.
